productDecisions: GeometryKernel contracts come before choosing TypeScript/WASM/WebGPU implementations
WebGPU is optional acceleration rather than a prototype dependency
marker layout is garment-constrained irregular nesting, not UV packing
visual corpus items require TruthLevel and LicenseProfile
image-to-3d outputs are mesh candidates, not direct pattern truth

candidateToExportInterop.thesis: Any mesh-derived, AI-derived, imported, or program-generated candidate must be normalized to canonical millimeters, scale-proven, measured, corrected, validated, marker-aware, and round-trip tested before promotion to PatternGraph or export.
candidateToExportInterop.firstPrototypePath: candidate JSON -> normalize to millimeters -> prove scale -> measure geometry/fabric footprint -> correct tiny issues -> validate -> export SVG -> reimport SVG -> round-trip report

ownablePipelineLane.thesis: Use Three.js for the product 3D viewport, TypeScript for the first PatternGraph loop, WASM for deterministic geometry kernels, and WebGPU only as optional acceleration after the static preview works.
ownablePipelineLane.firstPrototypePath: manual 2D reference annotation -> PatternGraph JSON -> 2D flats SVG/PDF -> Three.js static 3D assembly preview -> validation report
